verdict.rationale: YPOG documents a dedicated IP/IT/Data Protection practice that advises founders, startups and investors on building up and realizing IP assets, and its fintech team handles IP issues around NFTs. That practice is framed around transactions and investments, and nothing in the evidence describes trademark clearance, registration or brand enforcement work. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, trademark registration/prosecution, brand enforcement or litigation, a dedicated trademark/brand team, independent corroboration.
